jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.
Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.
Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.
Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.
Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.
Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.
Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.
Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.

This international company specializes in the manufacturing and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, producing high-quality injection-molded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 
 
 
• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment. 
 
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.  
 
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic  
 
• Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.  
 
• Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
• Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  
 
• Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.  
 
• Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.  
 
• Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts. 

 
 
• Associate’s degree or High-School Diploma.  
 
• You have relevant warehouse experience with a strong affinity to the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
•  Detail oriented character with a strong affinity to perform administrative work, fill out forms, logbooks, follow regular trainings.  
 
• You have an ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and across different functions.  
 
• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills. 
 
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times.  
 
• Ability to work independently and successfully. 
 
• You speak very good English or Dutch.

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!
 

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.
 

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:

•

We are hiring! For an international global player in the logistics sector (Puurs / Antwerp region), we are currently looking for a driven 
GL Accountant. Are you ready to perform at Champions League level in a dynamic environment where ownership and change are key?
 
 

•  

Location: Puurs / Antwerp region
  

•  

Company Culture: The bar is set high, but in return, you get a huge amount of freedom and autonomy.
  

•  

Team: You will join the Regional Shared Service Center (RSSC) for Benelux, a team of 30 accountants. The RSSC serves as an internal pilot within the international group: all accounting and controlling activities are centralized and optimized here.
   

Interested? Discover the job details below:
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

End-to-End closing: Taking full responsibility for the timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings from A to Z for your assigned international entities.
  

•  

Financial integrity: Ensuring financial reliability by performing complex balance sheet analyses and in-depth reconciliations.
  

•  

Reporting: Delivering accurate internal and external financial reports on time, in compliance with both local regulations (BE GAAP) and IFRS.
  

•  

Audit & compliance: Serving as the central operational point of contact for both internal and external auditors, and proactively safeguarding internal compliance controls.
  

•  

Process optimization: Actively contributing to the continuous improvement and streamlining of accounting processes within the Regional SSC, and proactively sharing knowledge within the team.
  

•  

Business partnering: Maintaining close internal contacts with the controlling team, which provides support during the closing process and performs deep-dive analyses.
  

Qualifications
 
 

•  

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  

•  

Experience: Dynamic accountant with strong experience in General Ledger (GL) accounting, preferably gained in a complex, changing, or international corporate environment.
  

•  

Knowledge & systems:
 
 

•  

In-depth and proven knowledge of BE GAAP and IFRS.
  

•  

Excellent systems knowledge: experience with 
SAP S/4HANA and 
Excel is an absolute must. Knowledge of Power BI is a strong asset.
    

•  

Languages: Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  

•  

Essentials:
 
 

•  

Autonomous, proactive, able to structure your own work, and only satisfied when the result is delivered.
  

•  

Resilient, thriving in a dynamic, transforming environment where structures and processes evolve rapidly.
  

•  

Strong, direct, and open communicator regarding what goes well, but also brave enough to discuss mistakes to learn together.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)
